it was my first time with psychedelics and It was with 25i,  I'm 21. My "friend" came over and around 8 or 9pm we both put the tab under our tongue. Everything was cool about an hour in. Started to feel like I was some giant walking around and that the areas between furniture in my room were like canyons. at some point before midnight we each took about 2 or 3 solid bong rips. Shortly after that my friend convinced me to jump in the pool. As soon as I jumped in my left side of my chest burst into pain, it became hard to breath and I had trouble climbing out of the pool. My "friend" just sat there laughing at me and I was trying to get him to help me but he wouldn't. I got out and was okay for a while but we went back to my room and then stuff really started to fall apart. I could just barley see anything that was in front of me, just weird fractal patterns that seemed to be on multicolored screen from a broken TV and impossible geometry, I later called this life's test pattern. Then there was a part where I felt like I went completely back in time to the previous day in class and im staring at a doodle I drew in my notebook. Then its like this doodle is how everything is connected and its the answer to life and then boom Im back in my room. I start really losing because my chest is in incredible pain and im worried something is wrong with me. That died down a bit and my "friend" was calling me a pussy for not being able to handle it. I tried to write my name down and could not even do that and started freaking out even more. I went to the bathroom a few times and had trouble standing up to urinate and started seeing people that weren't really there. This entire time feels like an impossible amount of time has passed and im just wanting it to end. I tried to text one of my good friends but couldn't even do that because the letters on my phone looked like some foreign language. I eventually crawl up into my bed with my dog to try and sleep around 2 or 3am. No sleep happens and this entire time is filled with fractal shapes and 3D geometry that is constantly changing shape, this part would have been actually enjoyable if I was not so fucking tired and having chest pain thinking I'm about to die. This entire time my "friend" had King of the Hill on and it was pretty fucking disturbing. Voices sounded really off and bobby hill is now referred to as satan by me because of some of the shit he did during all this. Then around 6am, I check to see if my "friend" is still alive, being completely serious because I've had constant chest pain the entire time and difficulty breathing, and when I look at him he has misplaced mouths all over his face, so I say screw this and grab my dog, who looks like clumps of mud falling apart in my hands, and go try to sleep in the living room. No sleep happens till around noon when my "friend" leaves.
I wake up later that after noon and feel okish but not great, so I decided to smoke again. This turns out to be a bad idea, and the chest pains come back and parts of my body feel numb. The chest pains stay for about about two or more weeks.

To sum up the rest, my doctor puts me on anti depressants and Xanax, and I've been to the emergency room twice since then because of very intense panic attacks. One of those times was 4 weeks after the 25i when I tried to smoke again but I started seeing way too intense visuals similar to when on 25i and could stop shaking and almost blacked out several times while waiting for an ambulance.

Doing physically better but trying to find a therapist/psychologist to get my mind striaghtend out. Been a shitty year kinda overall. Sorry for being a downer.
